description:
Confirmed in source: _project/scripts/green_unmerged_sweep.py:489-496 find_pinned_issue calls get_all(.../issues, state=all) and get_all stops at 10 pages of 100 (:398-414). Issues and PRs share numbers, so the original pinned issue #1508 fell outside the window (#2531 - #1508 = 1023) and #2531 was created as a duplicate (closed 2026-10-08 'duplicate of #1508'). The job is scheduled daily (nightly.yml, green-unmerged-sweep) and still affects the next write. Impact is a duplicate pinned issue, not a missed alert.
Work: look the pinned issue up by its body marker (<!-- green-unmerged-sweep -->) via the search API or another unbounded mechanism, keeping the existing title check and the reopen-if-closed behavior. The script deliberately uses no label; do not add one.
GATE-I: if the search API cannot return the pinned issue (rate limit or index lag), fall back to a label-free paginated scan sorted oldest first and record which mechanism was used. A lookup error must abort the run; it must never fall through to creating an issue.
